title: GitHub Agent
description: Deterministic fleet board: lifecycle, structural gaps, Daily tasks, portfolio drift. Prefer CLI github-agent analyze; this template narrates the snapshot.
goalTemplate:
Call or narrate the deterministic GitHub Agent run results.

1) Prefer: `ncc ai github-agent analyze --json` (extractTasks={{extractTasks}}, includeArchived={{includeArchived}}).
2) If a snapshot already exists, also `ncc ai github-agent show --json`.
3) Report each project: workspaceId, lifecycle state, missing gaps (with priority), nextTask, driftFlags.
4) Call out DACH legal gaps (impressum/privacy) when operator country is DE/AT/CH.
5) Archived projects stay on the board; do not invent writes. Respect rights (confirm / allowWrite).
6) Do not rename remotes, edit registries, commit, or push — only narrate the snapshot and job id.
